'''Anok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She sold gear to fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. Anok wore [[Color/Legends|red]] body [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Anok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', as the Operations Gear vendor for the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class. Her gear has changed frequently throughout the game's history, reflecting the current tier of gear. She was removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
